Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The agent asserted unverified zip codes (33149, 33139, 33154) based on a claimed manual review of the USGS page, but the USGS NAS record for Amphiprion ocellaris prior to 2020 indicates Tarpon Springs, FL (ZIP 34689). This lack of grounding and incorrect location-to-zip mapping directly led to the wrong final answer.
